intro: Lazy Dog Restaurant & Bar is a casual American chain built on comfort food with a dog-friendly patio and an eclectic menu that runs from the signature Campfire Pot Roast to globally inspired bowls, burgers, big salads and from-scratch dinners. Born in California, it leans into a cozy, lodge-style vibe. Below is the full Lazy Dog menu with prices for 2026.
quick_answer: At Lazy Dog, the Campfire Pot Roast is about $23.95, a half-pound cheeseburger is $14.95, and world bowls run $14.95 to $22.75. Comfort-food dinners like fried chicken and fish and chips are $22.95, salads are about $13 to $22, and starters are mostly $5 to $17. The Campfire Pot Roast and the bowls are the signatures. Prices vary by location.
hot_deal: Lazy Dog value: the Fireside Favorites (like a smaller Fettuccine Alfredo at $15) and the half-pound cheeseburger ($14.95) are the cheapest ways in, and the TV Dinner specials on certain nights are a known deal. Starters start at $5 and sides at $2.95. The app and rewards drop occasional offers. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: How much is the pot roast at Lazy Dog?
faqs.a: The signature Campfire Pot Roast is about $23.95, a slow-cooked comfort-food dinner with sides. The pot roast also appears as the Pot Roast Beef Dip sandwich at about $18.95. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: What is Lazy Dog known for?
faqs.a: Lazy Dog Restaurant & Bar is known for its cozy, lodge-style comfort food, an eclectic menu that pairs American classics like the Campfire Pot Roast with globally inspired world bowls, and its dog-friendly patios where you can dine with your dog.

faqs.q: Does Lazy Dog have a dog menu?
faqs.a: Yes. True to the name, Lazy Dog offers a dog-friendly patio and a simple menu for dogs (like grilled chicken or a brown rice bowl) so you can bring your dog along. It is one of the chain's signature touches.

Lazy Dog is a casual full-service restaurant and does not publish a full calorie guide, so calories are not listed here rather than guessed. The menu is broad, from lighter bowls and salads to hearty comfort dinners, so totals vary a lot.

faqs.q: What are the most popular dishes at Lazy Dog?
faqs.a: Favorites include the Campfire Pot Roast, the Honey Teriyaki and other world bowls, the half-pound cheeseburger, the fried chicken dinner, and the butter cake for dessert.
